title: 第3章 管他未来好不好先把饭儿吃个饱第4章 修炼虽然很苦但成仙一定很酷
slug: 我被系统坑成了造物主
content_zh:
见是如此，姜云天按捺住心中的急切，悄然退出。
青儿或是感受到姜云天的气息波动，也从打坐中醒来，走到姜云天床边，关心道“云天哥哥，你怎么样了，是不是饿了？”
不说则已，这一说，姜云天的肚子咕咕叫了起来。
姜云天还未开口，青儿忙道“云天哥哥，我给你准备仙食去，云天哥哥，你不要着急，我去去就来。”
姜云天拉着青儿的小手，心中激动万分，43岁的老处男，空虚寂寞只有五姑娘作伴，突然有了一个如仙子般的人儿对他百依百顺，悉心照顾
，姜云天激动的心，颤抖的手，一句话也说不出口。
青儿感受到的姜云天的激动心情，对姜云天说道，“云天哥哥，身体好些了吗，先吃饭，饭后青儿陪云天哥哥”
说话的声音越来越小，恰像蚊子哼哼。
姜云天激动地说道“青儿，拿饭食来，我要吃饭”
管他未来好不好，先把饭儿吃个饱。
须臾，一盘餐食摆在眼前，姜云天心中叫道“我特么，这是大米泡饭吗，对这就是大米泡饭，还是冷水泡了，大米一颗颗晶莹剔透，一看就是没有煮过的，这怎么吃啊。”
顿时，姜云天觉得饭也不用吃了，有点饱了。
白水泡饭他是真的吃不下，在蓝星的时候，不还得加点老抽才行吗？这修仙大陆要是都这么吃，还修个什么仙啊。
还真是不如在蓝星生活的畅快。
你若天天食无味，嘴里淡出一个鸟来，活一百万年又如何呢？人生不就是食人间烟火气，抚万千凡人心吗。
姜云天在蓝星虽然不算过得好，但也不算差。
从小被教育修身，齐家，治国平天下，长大后才发现，最多能修身，连齐家都没做到。
常言说成家立业，总以为成家最重要，后来才知道应该是业立家成，等到明白了，努力了买了房子，生活富足了，生活中却一直没有女主人，业立了，有房没有家。
在他30岁到43岁的这十几年，他的生活都是工作和工作之后的口腹之欲，现在看到修仙连吃都是如此寡淡，心下也凄惨，心绪冷然。
青儿看姜云天一动不动，以为只是无法自主炼化，便说道“云天哥哥，身体还没有完全恢得，灵泉灵米无法炼化，就由我帮云天哥哥炼化吧。

说着就动起手来”
姜云天一脸芒，在原主的记忆中找到了相关记忆，原来龙影大陆修士，修练进入练气期以后，皆以灵泉灵米为食进行练化，不用煎炒烹炸，只有没有进入修道的凡人才食这人间烟火气。
知道此间原委，姜云天亦不做任何挣扎，任由青儿炼化，他在这炼化的过程中，也慢慢地了解了基本的功法的运行情况。
青儿轻车熟路，将灵米拌着灵泉送入姜云天口中，手中结印，按在姜云天胸口，顿时，一股由灵泉和灵米化成的精纯气流按照青儿的功法指引，最终流遍全身，汇入丹田之中，此时姜云天感到有了一丝的灵力进入身体。
他觉得自己吸收完这碗灵食后，身体充满了力量。
可行了。
“青儿，你们除了这种吃食，就没有别的了吗？”
“云天哥哥，有别的啊，也有仙酒，仙食，各种美味”
“那你为什么不给我准备别的呢？”
“云天哥哥，你身体弱，其它仙酒仙食有杂质，你不能自主炼化”
“嗯，我会好起来的。”
“云天哥哥，你一定会好起来的，加油哦”
姜云天这下放心了，要是在这修仙大陆只能这样，没有口福，那还修个屁的仙，死了算求了。
经过五日调养，姜云天的身体也好起来了。
青儿每日悉心照顾，姜云天这个穿越老处男，看着天天忙来忙去的小娇娘，心思也就活泛起来。
姜云天也可以自主练化灵泉灵米了，常言道“饱暖思淫欲”
他开始准备言语撩拨青儿了，只是有点不知如何下手。
人性就是这样，当姜云天以了解卧病3年来外界发生的事情为由，让青儿给他讲了外界的事，他也渐渐了解了这个修仙世界，这是个以武力为尊的世界，善恶因实力而改变。
想到青鸳婆婆还给青儿一颗合欢丹，但连日来就没有任何动静，这让姜云天心中如猫抓一般，心中的恶念像风中之火，越烧越旺，只等一个契机，就会彻底爆发。
闲来无聊，想到系统上次发布任务以后，他一直没有接受任务，闭目打坐开始与系统对话：

“系统，我可以接受任务了吗，有什么任务可以给我的？”
系统机械音响起“由于宿主长时间未接受任务，系统已进入休眠状态，如要重新激活系统，请宿主挥刀自宫！”
content_en:
Seeing this, Jiang Yuntian suppressed the eagerness in his heart and quietly withdrew.
Qing'er may have felt Jiang Yuntian's breath fluctuation, so he woke up from meditation, walked to Jiang Yuntian's bed, and asked concernedly, "Brother Yuntian, how are you? Are you hungry?"
If he didn't say anything, Jiang Yuntian's stomach growled.
Before Jiang Yuntian could speak, Qing'er hurriedly said, "Brother Yuntian, I'll prepare immortal food for you. Brother Yuntian, don't be anxious, I'll be back as soon as I go."
Jiang Yuntian held Qing'er's little hand, feeling extremely excited. The 43-year-old virgin was empty and lonely with only five girls for company. Suddenly, there was a fairy-like person who was obedient and took good care of him.
, Jiang Yuntian's excited heart, trembling hands, could not say a word.
Qing'er felt Jiang Yuntian's excitement and said to Jiang Yuntian, "Brother Yuntian, are you feeling better? Let's eat first. After dinner, Qing'er will accompany brother Yuntian."
The voice became quieter and quieter, just like the hum of a mosquito.
Jiang Yuntian said excitedly, "Qing'er, bring me some food, I want to eat."
Regardless of whether his future is good or not, he should eat his fill first.
After a while, a plate of food was placed in front of him, and Jiang Yuntian shouted in his heart, "Holy shit, is this rice soaked rice? This is rice soaked rice, or soaked in cold water. The rice is crystal clear, and it looks like it has not been cooked. How can you eat it?"
Suddenly, Jiang Yuntian felt that there was no need to eat anymore and he was a little full.
He really couldn't eat rice soaked in plain water. When he was at Blue Star, didn't he have to add some dark soy sauce? If everyone in this land of cultivating immortals eats like this, how can they become immortals?
It’s really not as enjoyable as living in Blue Star.
If your food is tasteless every day and a bird appears in your mouth, so what if you live for a million years? Isn't life just about eating the fireworks of the world and touching the hearts of thousands of mortals?
Although Jiang Yuntian's life in Blue Star was not good, it was not bad either.
From a young age, I was taught to cultivate one's moral character, manage one's family, and govern the country and bring peace to the world. When I grew up, I realized that at best I could cultivate one's character, but not even one's family.
As the saying goes, starting a family is the most important thing. I always thought that starting a family is the most important thing. But later I realized that starting a career is the key to building a family. When I realized it, I worked hard to buy a house and lived a prosperous life, but I never had a mistress in my life. After I established a career, I had a house but no home.
In the more than ten years between the ages of 30 and 43, his life was all about work and the desire to eat after work. Now that he sees that cultivating immortals and even eating is so indifferent, he feels miserable and cold.
Seeing Jiang Yuntian motionless, Qing'er thought he just couldn't refine it on his own, so he said, "Brother Yuntian, your body has not fully recovered yet, so the spirit spring rice cannot be refined, so let me help brother Yuntian refine it."
Say that and start moving your hands."
Jiang Yuntian looked bright and found the relevant memory in the memory of the original owner. It turned out that the monks in Longying Continent, after entering the Qi training stage, all used Lingquan Lingmi as food for training. There was no need to fry or fry. Only mortals who had not entered the monastic realm could eat this human fireworks gas.
Knowing the whole story, Jiang Yuntian did not make any struggle and allowed Qing'er to refine it. During the refining process, he slowly understood the operation of the basic skills.
Qing'er was familiar with the journey and put the spiritual rice mixed with the spiritual spring into Jiang Yuntian's mouth. He formed a seal in his hand and pressed it on Jiang Yuntian's chest. Suddenly, a stream of pure air formed by the spiritual spring and spiritual rice followed the guidance of Qing'er's technique and finally flowed throughout his body and merged into his Dantian. At this time, Jiang Yuntian felt a trace of spiritual power entering his body.
He felt that after absorbing this bowl of spiritual food, his body was full of strength.
It works.
"Qing'er, do you have nothing else besides this kind of food?"
"Brother Yuntian, there are other things, including fairy wine, fairy food, and all kinds of delicious food."
"Then why don't you prepare something else for me?"
"Brother Yuntian, you are weak and other immortal wines and immortal foods contain impurities. You cannot refine them on your own."
"Yeah, I'll be fine."
"Brother Yuntian, you will definitely get better.Yes, come on”
Jiang Yuntian was relieved now. If this is the only way to be in this land of cultivating immortals, and there is no luck, then the immortal who is still cultivating shit will just die.
After five days of recuperation, Jiang Yuntian's health also improved.
Qing'er takes good care of her every day, and Jiang Yuntian, a time-traveling old virgin, becomes excited when he sees the little girl busying around every day.
Jiang Yuntian can also practice Lingquan Lingmi on his own. As the saying goes, "When you are full and warm, you think about lust."
He began to prepare words to seduce Qing'er, but he didn't know how to start.
Human nature is like this. When Jiang Yuntian asked Qing'er to tell him about the outside world on the pretext of understanding what had happened in the outside world during the three years since he had been ill for three years, he gradually understood the world of immortality. This is a world where force is respected, and good and evil are changed by strength.
Thinking that Granny Qingyuan had given Qing'er an Albizia Julibrissin Pill, but there had been no movement in the past few days, Jiang Yuntian felt like a cat scratching his heart, and the evil thoughts in his heart were like fire in the wind, burning more and more, waiting for an opportunity to explode completely.
Being bored, he thought that since the system last issued a task, he had not accepted the task. He closed his eyes and meditated and started talking to the system:
"System, can I accept the mission? Is there any mission you can give me? "
The system mechanical sound sounded, "Because the host has not accepted the task for a long time, the system has entered a dormant state. If you want to reactivate the system, please ask the host to commit suicide!" "
